data.reasoning: Both models independently reviewed the PKGBUILD and all associated files, finding no malicious code, suspicious network requests, or dangerous build steps. The package uses standard AUR practices for a git-tagged source. The only discrepancy was an API error in the first model when processing the LICENSE file, which incorrectly resulted in an 'inconclusive' overall verdict despite all security-relevant files being deemed safe.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by an HTTP 400 API error in the qwen model when attempting to audit the LICENSE file. This tool failure resulted in an 'inconclusive' verdict for that file, which cascaded to an overall 'inconclusive' result, even though the model's actual security assessment of the PKGBUILD and other files was 'safe'.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit LICENSE due to an API error, causing an inconclusive overall verdict.
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for LLM API errors on non-executable files (like LICENSE) to prevent a single transient failure from invalidating an otherwise complete and safe audit.
